name: Lake Como · 100 guests
source: BUDGET Wedding Planner EVENTS - Villa Balbiano 2026- Villa Pizzo - 100.pdf

items.details:
VILLA PIZZO 2026: 40.000 EURO for 1 day event (no
accommodation)
VILLA BALBIANO 2026:
Three days/two nights rental with accommodation
Rental fee is 200.000 euro
Security deposit is 35.000 euro fully refundable if no
damages
Check-in at 10am on the first day
Music curfew outside is 9.30pm
Afterparty ending time is 1am
Later is available at extra charge 3.000/hour
Checkout at 9pm on the third day
Up to 100 guests for an event
6 Suites of the Main Palazzo is included for
accommodation up to 12 ppl
All the Suites are double
Extra accommodation is available at extra charge
Max. capacity for accommodation is up to 30 ppl
Source value: 200.000 €

Accommodation for guests for 2 nights in the nearby hotel
TBD
Source value: 0 €

EXTRAS:
• Electricity for the main event – €7.500 (it does not
include wiring)
• Electricity for the additional event/installation days –
€3.500 (it does not include wiring)
• Extra hour for setup/dismantling – €3.000
• Afterparty extra time, - after 1am – €3.000 for the first
hour then TBC
• Black Marble toilet inside the Villa for VIP guests –
€1.000/event + extra toilet attendant
SERVICES:
• Toilet attendant €1.500-2.000/event TBC for 2025
• Security guard for the gate & the after party – €750/
event – one for each 40 ppl
OTHER:
Swimming pool party furniture rental:
SUNBEDS – 6 SUNBEDS, 7 UMBRELLAS AND UP TO 17
SUNCHAIRS – €3.500
Source value: 20.000 €

Aperitif & Dinner (Top Catering from Euro 300 per person
including beverages and wedding cake).
Source value: 30.000 €

Midnight snacks: pizza /burgers Euro 15 per person
Source value: 1.500 €

items.article: Wedding planner’s fee for 1 day event
items.details:
Personal wedding planner online for the whole period of
the preparation,
Design and concept development of your wedding,
Selection of wedding venue and side venues,
Site inspection of location,
Research and liaison with all contractors,
Budget management,
Developing of the decoration concept,
Stationary design,
Selection of Stylist, make up & hair artist,
Selection of Photographers and filmmakers,
Selection of Music company,
Selection of Catering or restaurants, tasting and
finalization of menu,
Timing planning of the wedding day and side days,
Detailed timing for suppliers and for the client,
Organization of Transfer,
Coordination of the wedding day.
Wedding planner’s fee for the wedding day - 20.000
euro + VAT, side event - 10.000 euro, +VAT 22% .
Source value: 24.400 €

Organization of side event (pizza party or brunch) +
coordination - 10.000 euro + VAT 22% /event
Source value: 12.200 €

Transport & accommodation cost of the agency (2 or 3
nights)
Source value: 2.000 €
